audience: developers who run webhooks through Hookdeck and need to find and fix failed deliveries

useCases.title: Find failed deliveries and their response status
useCases.text: List the events with status FAILED. Read one event and its delivery attempts to see the response status of each try.

useCases.title: Check how the project routes its events
useCases.text: List the connections that link sources to destinations, with their rules and pause state. Read one destination to see its type and config.

useCases.title: Review open issues that need a person
useCases.text: List the open issues that group failed deliveries, transformations or requests. Read one issue to see its details.

useCases.title: Investigate a rejected inbound webhook
useCases.text: List the inbound requests at a source, with their accepted or rejected status. Read one request to see its verification result and rejection cause.

useCases.title: Retry an event or pause a connection
useCases.text: Retry delivery of one event, which sends its payload to the destination again. Pause a connection to stop new deliveries, or unpause it to resume them.
